stem: Voltmarkt's 55-inch TV promotion showed a strong uplift. In the 2 weeks after it ended, the TV sold only about 80% of its baseline. What does this mean for the uplift reported from the promotion weeks alone?

options.text: It overstates the gain: some sales were pulled forward from later weeks
It understates the gain: the dip shows demand the promotion failed to meet
It is unaffected: weeks after a promotion never change its result
It used the wrong baseline: the pre-promo weeks were 80% too high
